content:
marco: Heads-up: new pricing micro-slate rolling to staging today (internal: SlateScope). Need final FAQ, calculator behavior, and webinar routing before soft-launch.
elaine: Nice. I'm leaning to a very compact FAQ: 3 Qs max (billing, commitments, security). Keep copy <30 words each and link to docs.
kevin: Tier rename suggestion: Starter / Team / Committed -> Starter, Team, Committed (keeps parity). Also proposing micro-phrases under each tier to clarify reserved vs hosted.
sam: Agree on phrases. For routing: estimator interactions -> Growth AE; partial calc email captures -> SDR nurture; >=$6k signals -> Enterprise queue. Add "calculator_signal" tag.
nina: Calculator UX: show a lightweight summary immediately, then modal email capture for full breakdown PDF + latency estimate. Add a tiny table in breakdown with cost vs 95th-pct latency. Ops care about that.
marco: Good. Please add a small benchmark blurb in results: "Representative: Hosted API ~120ms median; Dedicated <30ms p95" with link to bench page. Keep conservative.
kevin: CTA copy change: "Estimate your bill" for main CTA; secondary: "Download detailed breakdown" after capture. Also experiment with "See price range" vs exact price.
elaine: I'll prepare two FAQ variants: inline short answers, and accordion with expand counts. We should A/B test placement.
sam: For tracking/routing, propose webhooks + tags: estimator_slatescope_v1, webinar_slatescope_2026. Connect to /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_reg.
growth-bot: tags created: estimator_slatescope_v1, webinar_slatescope_2026. Webhooks set: /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_reg.
kevin: Quick UX question: should price slider default to 100k tokens/mo or 10k? Default affects estimator behavior. I vote for conservative default (10k) to avoid scaring small teams.
nina: 10k makes sense. Also surface an "ops impact" toggle that estimates p95 latency for Dedicated vs Hosted.
marco: Good microtest idea. For inbound emails from calc: include hidden param src=estimator_slatescope so analytics can join.
sam: I'll wire UTM template: ?utm_source=slatescope&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=slatescope_launch. Two sends: trial cohort + estimator converters last 30d.
kevin: Implementation note: modal flow: preview -> click "Get full breakdown" -> email modal -> show results + CTA to demo/webinar. Keep friction low.
nina: Analytics events to fire: slatescope_preview_shown, slatescope_email_capture, slatescope_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake.
growth-bot: Events registered in LaunchSpec: slatescope_preview_shown, slatescope_email_capture, slatescope_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake.
elaine: Timeline check: copy freeze by tomorrow EOD, staging QA Wed AM, soft-launch Thu PM, webinar signup opens Fri.
marco: Also add a micro-benchmark card under pricing: short sentence + link. Keep language defensible: "Based on internal perf tests on representative workloads".
kevin: I'll add the copy and wire both FAQ variants in staging.
sam: Routing checklist: SDR queue A for small trials, Growth AE for estimator leads, Enterprise AE for >=$6k. Add SFDC owner assignment event to track sales_handshake.
marco: Sweet. I'll collate tasks and ping when copy is final. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
